title: Letter to the Editor | Jackson Star and Herald - Ripley and Ravenswood | wvnews.com
text:
To the Editor:
Thank you to the volunteers for Ripley’s 4th of July celebration
The Ripley Convention and Visitors Bureau is deeply grateful for the many volunteers who have worked throughout the past year fundraising, planning, organizing, and giving their time to help make the Ripley 4th of July celebration possible. Events of this size do not come together overnight, and they certainly do not happen without the dedication of people who care deeply about their community.
While everyone hopes for a perfect event, the reality is that some things are simply beyond anyone’s control. Timelines often depend on outside companies, vendors, performers, equipment availability, and many moving parts that must come together on other people’s schedules.
If the Ripley CVB had a magic wand to make every detail happen exactly as planned, they surely would use it. But what matters most is that every decision and every effort is made with sincere intention and a heartfelt desire to bring joy to the community.
These volunteers work hard not only for the 4th of July, but throughout the entire year to create meaningful experiences for families, friends, and neighbors across Ripley. Their efforts are rooted in community spirit and in the belief that people deserve opportunities to gather, celebrate, and make memories together.
This year, that dedication is reflected in free concerts, free bouncy houses for children, free fireworks, and even the return of the carnival that so many people had hoped to see again.
Most importantly, the Ripley CVB is thankful for the volunteers who chose to step up, serve, and make things happen. It is easy to point out what is missing or to complain from the sidelines. It is something entirely different to give your time, your energy, and your heart to building something special for others.
Ripley is stronger because of those volunteers, and the entire community has reason to be grateful for their commitment, their hard work, and the love they pour into everything they do.
Brenda Mobley, Director
Ripley Convention & Visitors Bureau
